title: 2D Contouring
author: Matt Keeter
dateBasis: Browser companion added 27 September 2026 for the contouring program in the repository. The algorithm is Matt Keeter’s 2D contouring write-up. This is not a historical Comonad.Reader post.
editionNote: A new browser companion. The quadtree, marching squares, and dual walk follow TwoDContouring.hs. Feature rows are the intersection normals, because fromRows pts sends a rectangle corner outside its cell. The singular-value step is pure Haskell so the module can target wasm32-wasi.
